properties.description:
Move file access and watching out of HarnessApp into a configured filesystem contributor. Expose owned contracts and engine operations independent of agent sessions. Retain all visible paths, canonical file identities, stale-write rejection, deletion validation and watch invalidation. Update existing consumers and verify focused file/repository regressions.

Implemented as @super-app/filesystem-contributor: configured roots, graph operations, root-scoped guarded access and native change observation. Existing Workspace and watcher consumers use the extracted contracts. Verified filesystem/engine, deletion, document identity, watcher and application-owner regressions; repository type safety and dependency-depth checks passed.
properties.title: Extract reusable filesystem access and observation
